name: Qpit
source:
Comedy puzzle adventure. 
One day main character gets lost in a forest and finds shelter in a house. However, a terrible witch lives in the house. The witch makes protagonist to do the puzzles with the prospect of being turned into an animal on refusal. Is it possible to pass all the trials and defeat the witch?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
喜剧解谜冒险。
有一天，主角在森林中迷路，在一所房子里找到了庇护所。然而，房子里住着一个可怕的女巫。女巫让主角做谜题，如果主角拒绝，就有可能变成动物。是否有可能通过所有的考验并击败魔女呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
